claims.title: Complex-balanced physical-time gap: class-aware witnesses and a complete one-species positive certificate

quoted_fields.interface: Every finite rational complex-balanced mass-action model with supplied positive rational c and actual enabled class Gamma. The new positive constructor is restricted to ONE species, arbitrary arity/linkages/positive rational rates and initial population. Native physical-time rates and the full closed stationary form domain are retained.
quoted_fields.failure: The total infinite-class decision/certification algorithm and an exact-model undecidability reduction remain UNRESOLVED. Conditional witness search is not a terminating classifier, and arithmetic-hierarchy upper bounds are not hardness/completeness. A finite truncation cannot certify the required uniform positive lower bound. Full-orthant exponential-character tests are sufficient, not necessary. Source-reported Petri-net semilinearity and cited positive/zero-gap comparisons are imported only at the stated contract; citation handles/search excerpts are not an independent Capital governing-body read. No new scientific verification, code execution, primary-source recovery or novelty claim. The coordinator scoped assessment40–50 is correctness-assumed and nonadditive; full total decision remains open. Its elementary finite/infinite-class argument removes a need to assume the source-reported semilinearity/complexity import. The coordinator subsequently read Haslinger1805.04293v1 Section5: its closed-range/canonical-inverse theorem requires a uniform commutator coercivity bound on the relevant forms. Kernel, reaction-row/species dimensions and actual-class restriction are not supplied by ideal membership or coherent-state tests; no reaction-gap classifier is imported. CONTINUATION: One-species full positive certification is a standard path-method plus explicit cost construction, not a full arbitrary-dimensional gap decision or priority/90-level claim. The same ideal/c/actual class can have opposite gap signs when the quantitative reaction presentation changes. Polynomial-shift closed range is a standard exact reformulation, not a coercivity solver. Character witnesses require positive variance and strict certified inequalities, and completeness is unproved. No numerical fixture/code was rerun or held original recovered.
